baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of رَحْمَةً with مَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tender beneficence takes material form as continued useful and enjoyable life, while the temporal phrase makes that continuance a bounded extension rather than an unconditional state.

activation_trace.role: Tenderness, care, and beneficence supply the protecting quality of the exception.
Useful or pleasurable benefit gives concrete content to the mercy.
Extended preservation makes the benefit durative and explicitly provisional.
A finite time-span bounds the preserved enjoyment.

changed_reading.before: Mercy and enjoyment are two loosely coordinated favors.
changed_reading.after: Mercy is the act of keeping a beneficial mode of life available for a limited interval.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَتَاعًا followed by the goal-like temporal limit إِلَىٰ حِينٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Matāʿ can be equipment or provision used to meet needs and attain sufficiency; paired with a temporal endpoint, it reads as what enables passage through an interim rather than as consumption for its own sake.

activation_trace.role: Goods, food, or equipment used for needs make the enjoyment function as passage-provision.
The time-span provides the horizon through which the provision must suffice.
Beneficence explains why the needed means remain available.

changed_reading.after: Matāʿ is an interim kit of sustenance and utility, mercifully supplied only as long as the passage requires.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The limiting construction إِلَىٰ حِينٍ and the terminal branch of ح ي ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same word that denotes a stretch of time can carry the shadow of destruction or death, so the mercy is a stay of a terminal event, not simply a quantity of extra time.

activation_trace.role: The arrival of death or destruction gives the temporal limit a terminal edge.
Prolonged preservation occupies the interval before that terminal edge.
Mercy functions as the force granting the stay.

changed_reading.before: The endpoint is an unspecified neutral date.
changed_reading.after: The endpoint is potentially the awaited terminal event from which mercy grants a temporary stay.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The womb branch of رَحْمَةً joined to extended maintenance and an assigned time.
baseline_models.mechanism: The womb branch makes mercy imaginable as protective containment: life is maintained within a bounded environment until its due release-point.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies a containing and life-preserving spatial image for mercy.
Extended maintenance supplies the duration of containment.
An assigned time supplies a due endpoint rather than indefinite enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is an abstract favorable disposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy is a timed holding-environment that preserves vulnerable life until release.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured lunar stages, return after departure, ordered non-overtaking, and a circular course turn the focus interval into an allotted trajectory. Matāʿ extends along that trajectory but does not outrun its measure.

activation_trace.role: Extension that reaches its limit makes benefit a course with a culmination.
Assigning a time converts the focus endpoint into a determined slot.
Measured magnitude reaching its boundary supplies the limit governing the lunar stages.
Return after departure makes temporal extension cyclical rather than indefinite.
Precedence and racing clarify that each course has an order it cannot violate.
Circular motion supplies the bounded track on which allotted duration unfolds.

structural_cues: 36:37-40 moves through stripping, running, measured stages, return, non-overtaking, and orbit immediately before the vessel sequence.
The repeated ordered motions make time visible as a governed course rather than an empty delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the luminaries move through measured, returning, non-overtaking courses. Reader: the focus interval is assigned the same course-like order. Alternative: the cosmic sequence may establish power and order without specifying the character of the later reprieve.

changed_reading.before: Until a time means only that benefit eventually stops.
changed_reading.after: Benefit runs through an allotted course whose measure, succession, and endpoint are already built into its extension.

context_deltas.mechanism: Carriage in a ship is exposed to engulfment; when neither a responding rescuer nor extraction from the predicament is available, the focus exception identifies mercy as the direct stay of drowning and matāʿ as continued passage while still afloat.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent care becomes the operative counterforce to the threatened drowning.
Preserved continuation names the extra span of passage granted instead of immediate engulfment.
The finite duration bounds how long the stay of danger lasts.
Bearing a visible load supplies the preservation-through-carriage mechanism.
The waterborne vessel supplies the material site in which continued safety occurs.
Literal drowning supplies the counterfactual outcome that mercy suspends.
Succor and response clarify the denied intermediary rescue.
Extraction from a predicament supplies the rescue operation explicitly unavailable before the exception.

structural_cues: 36:44 opens with an exception directly after 36:43's conditional drowning and doubled denial of help.
36:41-43 narrows from carriage in a vessel to the exact failure mode that the exception interrupts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: people are carried in a ship, may be drowned, and then have neither succor nor extraction. Reader: the exception makes their remaining afloat the mercy itself and their ongoing passage the matāʿ. Alternative: mercy may denote only rescue from one incident, while matāʿ begins a separate general grant.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is generic kindness added after danger.
changed_reading.after: The fact of still being carried rather than engulfed is mercy in operation, granting a bounded continuation of the voyage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence links hoped-for mercy to protective response, then stages a dispute over sending out allotted provision to feed another. The focus matāʿ therefore becomes an entrusted stock held during a grace-period, not merely private consumption.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence supplies both received care and the quality that can be extended toward others.
Goods and food used for needs make matāʿ available for social distribution.
The finite interval makes possession temporary and therefore accountable.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the responsive posture associated with receiving mercy.
The verbal recurrence turns mercy from a static possession into an outcome still to be received.
The outward movement of wealth supplies the circulation demanded of temporary goods.
Allotted gift marks the stock as received rather than absolutely owned.
Feeding another supplies the concrete use against which stewardship is tested.

structural_cues: 36:45 repeats the mercy root immediately after the focus, and 36:47 turns divine provision into a contested command to spend and feed.
36:46's refusal of signs between them keeps the interval open to either response or waste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mercy is sought through protective response, while allotted provision is to be spent in feeding. Reader: temporary matāʿ is a trust whose proper use participates in mercy. Alternative: the spending episode may be an independent moral test rather than an explanation of matāʿ.

changed_reading.before: The temporary benefit is primarily the recipient's private enjoyment.
changed_reading.after: The reprieve carries allotted, need-serving goods whose circulation toward others is part of how the interval is answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single alarming cry ends ordinary agency, the trumpet initiates rising, and a temporally fixed promise of the Merciful becomes the day of recompense. The focus hīn is thus a promised mode-change from temporary use to collective presentation and account.

activation_trace.role: Prolonged preservation names the temporary life-span that expires at the transition.
The terminal-event branch lets the time-limit carry death or destruction rather than neutral chronology.
A time assigned to an action makes the terminal transition appointed.
The frightening cry supplies the abrupt event that closes ordinary activity.
Sending air into the trumpet supplies the initiating signal for the next mode.
Rousing what was still supplies the transition from repose to collective movement.
A promise fixed to a time or place makes the endpoint scheduled rather than accidental.
The Merciful's recurrence at fulfillment keeps mercy present even as the reprieve ends.
The eventful severity of the day supplies the accountable state beyond the deadline.

structural_cues: 36:49-54 moves without recovery from one cry, to inability to make a testament or return home, to trumpet, rising, promise, presence, and recompense.
The mercy root at 36:52 prevents the deadline from being read as the disappearance of mercy; what ends is the temporary mode of benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one cry interrupts life, a trumpet raises the still, and the Merciful's timed promise becomes a day of account. Reader: this sequence specifies the focus hīn as expiry into a new collective mode. Alternative: the focus may retain a nearer personal or historical deadline rather than point specifically to this collective event.

changed_reading.before: The benefit lasts until an unspecified death or cutoff.
changed_reading.after: The benefit is a reprieve whose promised expiry transfers its recipients from temporary use into collective presence and account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later couples extension of life with reversal in created form. This makes matāʿ's prolongation a transforming life-course: added duration can carry the beneficiary into decline rather than preserving the same capacity unchanged.

activation_trace.role: Prolonged preservation supplies the added life-span under reconsideration.
Extension that reaches its extremity allows duration itself to culminate and turn.
The bounded span makes prolonged life a course with internal phases.
Life extended through time directly activates the prolongation branch of matāʿ.
Turning a thing upside down supplies the reversal produced within the extension.
Complete formed constitution supplies the bodily domain that is reversed.

structural_cues: 36:68 places prolonging life and reversing created form in one conditional relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: extended life is paired with reversal in bodily creation. Reader: the focus matāʿ includes this changing trajectory, so more time is mercy without guaranteeing stable powers. Alternative: 36:68 may illustrate creation independently of the maritime reprieve.

changed_reading.before: Temporary enjoyment is a stable benefit simply available for more time.
changed_reading.after: The granted extension is itself a changing life-course; mercy preserves life while its capacities may pass into reversal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a ship onto a womb through shared carrying, enclosure, vulnerable life, water, and timed release; it remains anchored in the explicit womb branch of the focus mercy-root and in packet branches for inner carrying, ship, semen-water, and creation. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as a claim that the vessel or رَحْمَةً lexically means womb here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The womb branch of رَحْمَةً together with maintained extension and an assigned حِين.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies the focus-anchored image of protective containment.
Extended maintenance supplies preservation within the containing interval.
Assigned time supplies the due release-point of the analogy.
The inner pregnancy and fruit branch makes carrying descendants available as a gestational analogy.
The ship in water supplies the external vessel that carries vulnerable lineage.
Water ranging from drop to sea and including semen joins marine and generative material without equating them.
Bringing created life into existence supplies the developmental outcome of the containment.

changed_reading.before: The vessel merely transports already independent passengers, and mercy merely prevents an accident.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the vessel acts as an external womb: mercy carries and maintains a lineage through lethal water until a due emergence.

strongest_changes: The no-rescuer sequence makes continued flotation and carriage the operation of mercy itself.
Cosmic measures and the later single cry turn حِين into an allotted course ending in a promised collective transition.
The immediate mercy and provision episodes recast matāʿ as a temporary trust whose use includes protection, spending, and feeding.
The later aging reversal shows that extension preserves life without freezing its capacities.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the three focus nouns behave as one bounded preservation mechanism: mercy supplies the protecting force, matāʿ the usable and carried interval, and حِين its measured terminus. It also exposed a carefully containable vessel/womb analogy that the focus-only reading could not fully develop.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus حِين can still point to a personal death, a historical cutoff, or the collective blast; the packet strengthens the last without eliminating the others.
The stewardship reading depends on treating the 36:45-47 sequence as an explanation of reprieve rather than only a neighboring exhortation.
The external-womb model is a cross-domain material analogy and should not be promoted into lexical equivalence.
